title: Science, Technology, and Artificial Intelligence
summary: Scientific evidence, emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, and responsible innovation.
whyItMatters: Responsible technology discussion requires understanding evidence, models, limitations, applications, and social consequences.

mentalModel.title: Claim, method, evidence, limitation
mentalModel.content: Evaluate scientific statements by asking how knowledge was produced and where uncertainty remains.

mentalModel.title: AI systems optimize patterns, not truth
mentalModel.content: Separate training data, model behavior, output quality, and human accountability.

ruleBlocks.title: Assess evidence quality
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish experiment, observation, correlation, replication, and expert review.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe technological systems in layers
ruleBlocks.content: Name input, processing, output, feedback, and human control.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate benefits and risks together
ruleBlocks.content: Consider accuracy, bias, privacy, transparency, access, and responsibility.

tables.title: Responsible Innovation Framework
rows: Under which conditions does it work?

examples.de: Ein statistischer Zusammenhang beweist noch keinen ursächlichen Effekt.
examples.en: A statistical association does not yet prove a causal effect.

examples.de: Das mit großen Datenmengen trainierte Modell erzeugt wahrscheinliche Antworten.
examples.en: The model trained on large datasets generates probable answers.

examples.de: Technische Leistungsfähigkeit ersetzt keine gesellschaftliche Entscheidung über den Einsatz.
examples.en: Technical capability does not replace a social decision about use.

commonMistakes.wrong: AI understands information exactly like a person.
commonMistakes.correct: Describe the system's observable function and limits.
commonMistakes.reason: Human metaphors can hide technical differences.

commonMistakes.wrong: One study settles a complex question.
commonMistakes.correct: Consider method, replication, and the wider evidence base.

comparisons.summary: Scientific prose frequently compresses process information into participial attributes.
The communication lesson turns technical structure into audience-appropriate explanations.
